item.text: The source contains several intentionally empty proof blocks, especially in the Cuckoo state-machine inductiveness and atomic-update closures. I’m preserving those existing holes and will only fill obligations that Verus reports as missing; the local Verus launcher also needs the installed Rust toolchain path exposed.
